index_policy.mapping: For each broad bin,report distinct panel gene symbols with at least one eligible annotation to that bin itself or any of its is_a descendants. Only exact enables qualifies; contributes_to and NOT do not become enables. Multiple annotations or references for the same gene/bin count once. A gene may occur in several bins; these categories are not an exclusive partition. Every supplied annotation record for each panel gene is retained,including other aspects,nonexperimental evidence and qualifier distinctions.
index_policy.scope: This is an index of source-qualified existing annotation coverage across recorded contexts,not an experiment proving activities in every condition. Genes with no eligible bin mapping are documentation gaps under this explicit panel/filter/is_a-only view,not proteins with no molecular function. Other GO relations,including part_of/regulates/has_part,are deliberately outside this conservative is_a-only index. ND root and nonexperimental evidence are not experimental support. No enrichment,population frequency or mechanism prediction is requested.

gaf.scope: Saccharomyces cerevisiae public annotation analysis only; no genetic design or experiment

ontology.source_kind: Official QuickGO classified is_a transitive ancestry API. Edges export reachability closure,not immediate parents; no authoring-ontology inference or hand-added expected-answer edges.
ontology.version_scope: Official about metadata fetched immediately before and after the ancestry batch agrees. Frozen payload bytes and hashes are the release evidence; this is not a claim of an atomic full-database transaction.

ontology.scope: Ancestry for all source panel molecular-function term IDs and all declared bins. This is not the full GO release and does not invent immediate-edge placement; self ancestors are retained in raw JSON and omitted from traversal edges to avoid self loops.

source_provenance.ontology_export: Official QuickGO classified transitive is_a ancestry responses are exported as child-to-every-ancestor reachability closure edges,not immediate parents. No authoring-OBO omitted edges are patched by hand. Every requested term is active molecular_function and present exactly once in the archived response. Named term records cover the queried original IDs and bins; additional intermediate ancestor IDs remain explicit graph IDs without fabricated names. Complete is_a ancestor closure of all supplied molecular-function annotation terms,not only the eligible terms,and all six declared broad bins. Other aspects and relation types are not silently relabelled. All original qualifiers,evidence,references,dates,extension and gene form fields of every selected gene GAF row remain unchanged; line-based annotation IDs are added for provenance. No eligible list,binned result or deduplicated gene coverage is supplied as public data.
source_provenance.read_scope: Complete official QuickGO28-term response,API documentation,and official11experimental-code list; plus official positive-annotation upward is_a grouping,relation-specific limits,NOT direction,open-world missingness and nonexclusive broad annotation summaries. This is a custom conservative index,not an official complete GO-slim output.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
